# Security

Please report security issues through a
[private security advisory](https://github.com/superneoai/superneo.ai/security/advisories/new).
If that form is unavailable, email [hello@superneo.ai](mailto:hello@superneo.ai).

Include the affected URL, a concise description, reproduction steps, and the potential impact. Do not include sensitive visitor information. SUPERNEO will acknowledge a report within five business days and coordinate disclosure after a fix is available.

Do not open a public issue for an unpatched vulnerability.
